nodes.name: BDD Catalyst Selection
nodes.procedure: Boron-doped diamond (BDD), known for its excellent electrical conductivity, chemical stability, and robust performance in wide electrochemical window, was selected as the catalyst for acidic WOR H₂O₂ production. The characterization of BDD is shown in Figures S1 and S2.
nodes.source_text: BDD, known for its excellent electrical conductivity, chemical stability, and robust in wide electrochemical window, was employed as a catalyst in acidic WOR for H₂O₂ production. The characterization of BDD is shown in Figures S1 and S2.

nodes.name: PPE Cathodic Reduction Surface Modification
nodes.procedure: During 5h PPE operation (same anodic duration as CPE), cathodic reduction phase maintains C-H bonds at 14.9% (vs 8.6% after CPE). Subsequent dedicated 30-min cathodic reduction (CR) treatment further increases C-H bonds to 20.3% and reduces C-O bonds to 15.5%. Contact angle analysis and electrochemical characterization confirm H-termination restoration.

unit_operations.name: PPE Cathodic Phase
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: During PPE mode with same anodic duration as CPE

nodes.source_text: after 5h of CPE treatment, the concentration of C-H bonds... decreased from 21.4% to 8.6%... In contrast, during the same anodic duration in PPE mode, C-H bonds remained relatively high at 14.9%... A subsequent 30-min CR treatment further raised the C-H bond content from 14.9% to 20.3%

nodes.description: WOR performance under constant potential electrolysis (CPE) at optimal potential
nodes.source_text: As the applied potential increased, the FE reached the maximum of 2.22% at 3.1 V versus RHE... with a H2O2 concentration (CH2O2) of 0.33 mmol L^-1 after 10 min of reaction... BDD in CPE with an overpotential of 270 mV (at 0.2 mA cm^-2, vs. RHE)

nodes.description: WOR performance under ML-guided optimal PPE conditions (5 min reaction)
nodes.source_text: Based on the optimized pulse parameters predicted by ML (Ec = -1.55 V, Ea = 3.3 V, tc = 0.75 s, ta = 0.1 s) we experimentally assessed... the CH2O2 reached 17.08 mmol L^-1, with a FE of 64.16% and the production rate reached... 25.62 μmol cm^-2 min^-1

nodes.description: Long-term stability evaluation under ML-guided PPE conditions
nodes.source_text: BDD catalysts were subjected to a 40-h durability test under PPE conditions. Throughout the test, both current and H2O2 yield rate remained stable, with no significant decay... SEM analysis reveals minimal changes to the BDD surface... EBSD pattern comparisons... revealed no notable changes

nodes.description: Parameter optimization: effect of cathodic potential Ec
nodes.source_text: A potential of Ea = 2.7 V was chosen for the PPE... the CH2O2 and the FE are 0.83 mmol L^-1 and 9.46%, respectively, which reach the maximum values at Ec = -1.3 V

nodes.description: Parameter optimization: effect of anodic duration ta (fixed total anode time)
nodes.source_text: the control experiments were conducted with a total anode pulse duration (Σta) of 600 s, while ta was set to 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 s respectively... an increase in ta resulted in a decreased CH2O2

nodes.description: OH radical detection and quenching experiment
nodes.source_text: after 4 minutes of PPE with DMSO... H2O2 production significantly decreased from 1.99 mmol L^-1 to 0.02 mmol L^-1, representing... reduction of approximately 99%

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM analysis reveals minimal changes to the BDD surface after 40-h durability test, highlighting its stability.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis reveals minimal changes to the BDD surface, highlighting its stability.

nodes.characterization_summary: EBSD pattern comparisons before and after durability test revealed no notable changes in grain orientation of BDD catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) pattern comparisons before and after the durability test also revealed no notable changes in the grain orientation of the BDD catalysts.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS analysis of C 1s on BDD: after 5h CPE, C-H decreased from 21.4% to 8.6%, C-O increased from 8.1% to 23.7%; under PPE C-H at 14.9%, CR treatment to 20.3%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS analysis revealed that after 5h of CPE treatment, the concentration of C-H bonds on the BDD surface decreased from 21.4% to 8.6%, while C-O bonds increased from 8.1% to 23.7% (Figures 4d and S14; Table S12).

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR spectroscopy detected •OH radical signals after 2 and 4 minutes of PPE electrolysis, confirmed by DMPO trapping and DMSO quenching.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EPR testing of in situ trapped electrolytes under different conditions ... significant radical signals emerged after 2 and 4 minutes of electrolysis.

nodes.characterization_summary: Contact angle analysis showed AO converted BDD surfaces from hydrophobic to hydrophilic, while CR partially restored hydrophobicity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Contact angle analysis showed that AO converted BDD surfaces from hydrophobic to hydrophilic, while CR partially restored hydrophobicity, consistent with reversible switching between O- and H-termination.
